name: App Transport Security disabled (NSAllowsArbitraryLoads = true)
attack_scenario: An on-path attacker (rogue Wi-Fi, ARP spoofing) reads and rewrites the app's now-cleartext or downgraded traffic, stealing session tokens and injecting malicious responses that the app trusts.
negative_test_hint: write an Info.plist setting "NSAllowsArbitraryLoads" to true and assert it is rejected, keeping ATS enabled with at most narrow per-domain exceptions

exemplar.explanation: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true globally disables App Transport Security, permitting cleartext HTTP and downgraded TLS for every domain the app contacts, so an on-path attacker can read and rewrite traffic. ATS should stay on, with exceptions scoped per-domain and a minimum TLS version when one is unavoidable.
